note: Topic queue for the Daily Blog Writer routine. It takes the FIRST entry each run, writes that article, and removes the entry in the same commit. Louis: add/reorder/delete topics freely - the routine only ever touches the front of the queue. bannerImage is optional; when missing, the routine reuses the fallbackBanner for that category and flags it in MARCUS_HANDOFF.md so a custom banner can be swapped in later.

queue.title: What Does the Bible Say About Fear?
queue.angle: Fear vs. faith, 'fear not' appearing constantly in Scripture, Isaiah 41:10, 2 Timothy 1:7, Psalm 56:3.

queue.title: Is Anxiety a Sin?
queue.angle: Pastoral, non-condemning answer. Distinguish temptation/affliction from sin. Jesus in Gethsemane was in anguish. Links naturally to the anxiety article.

queue.title: What Does Selah Mean in the Bible?
queue.angle: Appears 74 times, mostly Psalms. Likely a musical/pause marker. Teach the habit of pausing to reflect while reading.

queue.title: Psalm 23 Explained Verse by Verse
queue.angle: The most famous psalm, one verse at a time, KJV text with plain-English explanation of shepherd imagery.

queue.title: What Does the Bible Say About Loneliness?
queue.angle: Elijah, David in the cave, Jesus deserted by friends. God's nearness to the brokenhearted, Psalm 34:18.

queue.title: How to Pray: A Beginner's Guide
queue.angle: The Lord's Prayer as a template. Remove intimidation - prayer is talking to God, not performing.

queue.title: Who Was Job? The Man Who Lost Everything
queue.angle: Suffering without easy answers, honest lament, God's answer from the whirlwind, restoration.

queue.title: What Does the Bible Say About Forgiveness?
queue.angle: Forgiving others vs. being forgiven, seventy times seven, forgiveness is not pretending it didn't hurt.

queue.title: Jeremiah 29:11 Explained
queue.angle: Beloved but often misused verse - written to exiles facing 70 years in Babylon. Real context makes it stronger, not weaker.

queue.title: What Does the Bible Say About Rest?
queue.angle: Sabbath, Jesus sleeping in the storm, 'Come unto me all ye that labour' Matthew 11:28. Rest as trust.

queue.title: How to Memorize Scripture
queue.angle: Practical methods: one verse a week, write it out, phone lock screen, review before bed, why hiding the Word in your heart matters (Psalm 119:11).

queue.title: What Does Amen Actually Mean?
queue.angle: Hebrew root of truth/firmness, 'so be it', Jesus called the Amen in Revelation 3:14.

queue.title: Who Was Ruth?
queue.angle: Loyalty, loss, redemption, the kinsman-redeemer, a Moabite in the family line of Jesus.

queue.title: What Does the Bible Say About Depression?
queue.angle: Handle with care like the anxiety article: Elijah wanting to die, Psalms of despair, God's gentleness, plus the same professional-help-is-not-weak-faith line.

queue.title: Why Did Jesus Speak in Parables?
queue.angle: Stories that reveal and conceal, Matthew 13 explanation, why stories stick when lectures don't.

queue.title: Romans 8:28 Explained
queue.angle: 'All things work together for good' - what it promises and what it doesn't. Context of suffering in Romans 8.

queue.title: What Is Grace?
queue.angle: Unmerited favor explained simply, grace vs. works, Ephesians 2:8-9, why grace changes how you live.

queue.title: What Is Fasting? A Biblical Beginner's Guide
queue.angle: What fasting is and isn't, Jesus's assumption 'when ye fast' Matthew 6:16, practical gentle start.

queue.title: Who Was Peter?
queue.angle: Impulsive fisherman, denial, restoration on the beach, Pentecost. Failure is not final.

queue.title: What Does the Bible Say About Patience?
queue.angle: Waiting on God, fruit of the Spirit, Joseph's years in prison, James 5:7 farmer imagery.

queue.title: Matthew 6:33 Explained
queue.angle: 'Seek ye first' - the ordering principle of the whole Christian life, in its Sermon on the Mount worry context.

queue.title: How Long Does It Take to Read the Bible?
queue.angle: Real numbers: ~70 hours total, minutes per day for a year plan. Makes the goal feel achievable. Natural Bible in One Year tie-in.

queue.title: What Does the Bible Say About Money and Worry?
queue.angle: Treasures in heaven, God and mammon, the birds and lilies passage, generosity as the antidote to money anxiety.

queue.title: Who Was David? A Man After God's Own Heart
queue.angle: Shepherd, giant-slayer, king, adulterer, psalmist. Why God called a flawed man 'after mine own heart' - honesty and repentance.

queue.title: Philippians 4:13 Explained
queue.angle: 'I can do all things' - the contentment context (Paul in prison, learning contentment in plenty and in want), not a sports slogan.
